row.notes: (sys, out vec4, id*): finds the decal (+0x20 == *id) in sys+0x178..+0x180 and its area record in the sys+0x98 list (stride 0x108, +0xc == decal+0x28); normalises the area axes [[rec+0x80]]+0x10 and [[rec+0x88]]+0x10, builds their normal, projects decal pos +0x30 onto the plane through [[rec+0x58]]+0x10 and returns the two in-plane coordinates (dot with each axis). Zero if not found. (lane owner review requested) Better name: Game_DecalCustomisation_ProjectDecalToArea (bound record keeps its name).
